plain: Once upon a time, in a quiet pond, lived a small frog named Pip. Every night, Pip looked up at an old oak tree standing tall beside the water and sighed, wishing he could grow tall like the tree instead of hopping low on lily pads. One evening, the moon rose bright and silver above them both. "Dear Moon," Pip called out, "I wish I were tall like the tree." The moon glowed softly and said, "But Pip, you can swim and jump and sing songs at night that the tree never could. The tree wishes it could dance in the water like you." Pip looked at the tree and realized how lucky he was to have his own gifts. From then on, Pip thanked the pond, the tree, and the moon each night for exactly what he had.

plain: Here's a great mix for an Indian-themed house party: Start with appetizers like samosas (crispy pastry with spiced potato filling), paneer tikka (grilled marinated cheese cubes), and pakoras (vegetable fritters) served with mint chutney. For mains, offer butter chicken or paneer butter masala for a rich, crowd-pleasing curry, chana masala (spiced chickpeas) for a vegetarian option, and biryani, a fragrant spiced rice dish, as a hearty centerpiece. Pair these with naan or roti for scooping, and raita, a cooling yogurt side, to balance the spice. For dessert, gulab jamun (sweet fried dough balls in syrup) or kheer (rice pudding) are easy crowd favorites. Most of these can be prepped ahead, which makes hosting much less stressful the day of the party.

plain: The rocket is called the Space Launch System (SLS), NASA's super heavy-lift launch vehicle designed to send crew and cargo to the Moon and beyond as part of the Artemis program. It's used alongside the Orion spacecraft, which carries astronauts. The SLS made its first uncrewed test flight, Artemis I, in November 2022, sending an Orion capsule around the Moon and back. Future missions, like Artemis II, plan to carry astronauts on a lunar flyby, while Artemis III aims to land astronauts, including the first woman and first person of color, on the lunar surface. The SLS is the most powerful rocket NASA has built since the Saturn V used in the Apollo program, and it's central to NASA's long-term goal of a sustained human presence around the Moon.

plain: A stand-up paddleboard (SUP) is a large, flat board you stand on and propel using a single, long paddle with one blade, giving you an elevated view and engaging your core and balance more actively. A kayak is a low-sitting, enclosed or sit-on-top boat you paddle from a seated position using a double-bladed paddle, alternating strokes on each side. Kayaks generally offer more stability for beginners, better speed and efficiency over longer distances, and more protection from wind and waves, especially closed-cockpit touring kayaks. SUPs offer a better full-body workout, easier storage and transport since many are inflatable, and more versatility for activities like SUP yoga or fishing while standing. Kayaks tend to be better for rougher water, while SUPs excel in calm, flat water for casual paddling or fitness.

plain: German Christmas markets (Weihnachtsmarkte) are popular for a mix of history, atmosphere, and tradition. The markets create a cozy, festive atmosphere with wooden stalls, twinkling lights, and the smell of mulled wine and gingerbread filling the cold winter air. They offer handmade crafts, ornaments, and local food that make for a communal, sensory experience distinct from typical shopping. Socially, they serve as a gathering place for friends and families during the darkest, coldest part of the year, offering warmth and connection. Their popularity has also grown internationally as tourists specifically travel to Germany during Advent to experience them.

plain: You feel lighter in a swimming pool because of buoyancy, a force described by Archimedes' principle: water pushes upward on your body with a force equal to the weight of the water your body displaces. Since the human body is close to the density of water, and often slightly less dense due to air in the lungs and body fat, a large portion of your actual weight is counteracted by this upward buoyant force, especially when you're mostly submerged. This is why standing in chest-deep water can make you feel like you weigh only a fraction of your normal body weight, and why swimming feels almost weightless compared to moving on land. This principle is also why pools are used for physical therapy, since it reduces stress on joints while still allowing exercise.
